svg.title: PB-EL-001 ELONGATED paddle - rib support mould
svg.text: SCALE 1:2 · CLOSED MOULD, MOULDED RIB SUPPORT BLACK, M6 BOLT
SCALE 2:1 · TEETH INTERLOCK; THE GAPS ARE THE WALLS AND THE FRAME
Ejector pin Ø4 × 40 (or a drill shank)
Release wax + PVA; flat platens + clamps or a press
TRAY (1) + LID (2): output/mould/elongated_mould_bottom / _top (.stl / .step). THE CAVITY BETWEEN THEM IS THE RIB
SUPPORT (SHEET 3); THE TEETH ARE ITS FLUTES. THE LID SEATS ON THE TRAY RIM: CORE HEIGHT 10, WALLS 1.6.
PRINT BOTH BACK DOWN, TEETH UP: ≥ 5 WALLS, ≥ 40 % INFILL, 0.12–0.16 LAYERS FOR THE TEETH, IRONING ON FLAT TOPS.
NEEDS A ≥ 440 mm BED, OR MACHINE THE STEP FROM ALUMINIUM. ABOUT 1.4 + 1.1 kg OF PLA AT 100 %.
PLA SOFTENS NEAR 55 °C: ROOM-TEMPERATURE-CURE EPOXY ONLY. FOR A WARM CURE PRINT IN PETG, ASA OR PA-CF.
PREPARE: SAND THE CAVITY FACES (P400 → P800), SEAL (EPOXY COAT), WAX ×3 + PVA. PRESS THE 4 DOWEL PINS (4) INTO
THE TRAY. PLUG THE EJECTOR HOLES FROM BELOW WITH TAPE.
FILL (FORGED CARBON): CHOP CARBON TOW TO 10–25 mm, WET IT WITH EPOXY (≈ 40 % FIBRE BY VOLUME). PACK THE WALL
GAPS AND THE FRAME FIRST, THEN THE SOLID HANDLE ZONE; OVERFILL BY ≈ 10 %.
CLOSE: LID OVER THE DOWELS, BOLTS (3) FINGER-TIGHT, THEN PRESS BETWEEN 2 FLAT, STIFF PLATENS OR IN A PRESS UNTIL
THE LID SEATS ON THE RIM; TIGHTEN THE BOLTS. EXCESS RESIN LEAVES BY THE OVERFLOW GROOVE AND THE VENTS.
CURE (24 h AT ROOM TEMPERATURE), SPLIT AT THE PRY NOTCHES, LIFT THE LID STRAIGHT UP, PUSH THE PART OUT WITH THE 4
EJECTOR PINS. TRIM THE FLASH, DRILL AND FIT THE M3 INSERT (SHEET 3). THE PART WEIGHS ≈ 271 g.
TRIAL FIRST: PRINT THE RIB SUPPORT STL IN PLA AND CLOSE THE EMPTY MOULD ON IT – IT MUST SEAT FULLY.
RIB SUPPORT MOULD · TRAY + LID, TEETH INTERLOCK · 244 × 429 mm
